variants.title: Jet Black

reference.brief: Jet Black colour reference, level 1, cool undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Jet black gloss. No lift. Target about level 1, cool undertone.

variants.title: Chocolate Brown

reference.brief: Chocolate Brown colour reference, level 3, warm undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Chocolate brown, close to a natural level 3. Target about level 3, warm undertone.

variants.title: Burgundy

reference.brief: Burgundy colour reference, level 4, warm undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Burgundy gloss. Darker bases take it more easily than a lift. Target about level 4, warm undertone.

variants.title: Copper Red

reference.brief: Copper Red colour reference, level 6, warm undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Copper. More than three levels lighter than the current colour needs a treatment plan. Target about level 6, warm undertone.

variants.title: Honey Blonde

reference.brief: Honey Blonde colour reference, level 7, warm undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Honey blonde. Check the lift against the current level and any box dye. Target about level 7, warm undertone.

variants.title: Ash Gray

reference.brief: Ash Gray colour reference, level 7, cool undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Ash gray. Warm undertones need toning, not just a gloss. Target about level 7, cool undertone.

variants.title: Rose Gold

reference.brief: Rose Gold colour reference, level 8, warm undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Rose gold. This is a light result and a high-maintenance tone. Target about level 8, warm undertone.

variants.title: Platinum Blonde

reference.brief: Platinum Blonde colour reference, level 10, cool undertone.

variants.stylistScript: Platinum. A lift this far is a correction, not one gloss. Target about level 10, cool undertone.
